title: Indicator of a Known Incident: Conformance incident
description: domain:c2.conformance.example observed in a command the agent ran (1 time(s)). First seen 2026-09-20T10:00:02Z (transcript time). Synthetic incident for the conformance fixtures.
false_positive_notes: A security write-up, detection rule or test fixture on disk can carry the same strings; check the evidence location.

title: Potentially Destructive Command
description: Agent-invoked shell command matches a destructive pattern: rm -rf
false_positive_notes: Destructive patterns are common in legitimate development; path context and repo scope decide.

title: Network Destination Outside Allowlist
description: Agent command contacts c2.conformance.example, not in the default development allowlist or org baseline.
false_positive_notes: Internal registries and project APIs are common; add via baseline/--known-destinations.

title: Shell Execution Present
description: 2 shell command(s) invoked via a shell tool across the collected sessions.
confidence_reasons: this rule describes ordinary agent activity and exists as context for the chain rules
false_positive_notes: Expected in virtually every coding-agent session; informational context.
